title: Find the Degree of Each Vertex
summary: Given an n x n adjacency matrix for an undirected graph, calculate the degree of each vertex by counting the number of edges connected to it, and return an array where each element represents the degree of the corresponding vertex.
statement: Given an n x n adjacency matrix for an undirected graph, calculate the degree of each vertex by counting the number of edges connected to it, and return an array where each element represents the degree of the corresponding vertex.
constraints: matrix is the symmetric zero-one adjacency matrix of an undirected graph.
The degree of a vertex is the number of incident edges.
reference_solution:
def adjacency_matrix_vertex_degrees(matrix):
    return [sum(row) for row in matrix]
hints: Each matrix row describes all neighbors of one vertex.
A one contributes one incident edge to that row’s vertex.
Preserving row order preserves vertex-index order.
editorial: Preserving row order preserves vertex-index order.

tests.explanation: Every vertex connects to the other two, so all degrees are two.
The graph has no edges, so both degrees are zero.
